summary: Both the input length and recovered integer range are bounded by 100, which is too narrow for an honest runtime-scaling verdict; the accepted implementation performs one set construction and one bounded range scan.

workload_bound.unit: integer values in the recovered range
workload_bound.source_constraint: 1 <= nums[i] <= 100 and nums contains unique integers

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted source inserts at most 100 unique values and checks at most 100 consecutive range values, establishing O(n + R) expected work over the complete legal bounds.

The dedicated regression checks every subset of values 1 through 10 with at least two elements in forward and reverse order, plus deterministic randomized unique subsets across the complete 1-through-100 value domain.
